global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. A single nori sheet rests atop, all nestled in a white bowl against a vibrant red background, illuminated by soft, even lighting.

regions.background: The red table surface appears smooth and slightly glossy, with subtle texture variations and faint white cable traces visible.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly flared rim, and subtle light reflections.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is rich, dark brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and chopped green onions.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, glossy, and crinkled, with a rectangular shape and uneven, textured surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with glossy surface, irregular shape, and browned edges.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, curved pieces with glossy, moist surfaces.
